title: BacklogItem
description: A single item in the 3APK Backlog Notion database. Mirrors the Go BacklogItem struct and drives Notion field definitions, skill output shapes, and CSV export columns.

id.description: Unique identifier for the backlog item (e.g. UUID or Notion page ID).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the story.

raw_request.description: Original raw request text before AI refinement.

user_story.description: Refined user story in 'As a … I want … so that …' format.

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable acceptance criteria derived from the user story.

estimate_hours.description: AI-suggested or team-adjusted estimate in hours. Nullable when not yet estimated.

estimate_points.description: AI-suggested or team-adjusted estimate in story points. Nullable when not yet estimated.

dependencies.description: IDs or titles of other backlog items this story depends on.

risks.description: Identified risks or unknowns for this story.

dor.description: Definition of Ready checklist evaluation for this item.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the backlog item. Draft = newly created; Refining = skill chain in progress; DoR_Pass = ready for sprint; DoR_Fail = needs more refinement; Planned = committed to a sprint; Done = completed.
